content: Ligand 2 is a good illustration of the trade this run has settled into: methylamino posts the joint-highest activity at 0.61 but only QED 0.788, because the extra donor pushes it to three H-bond donors and raises polar surface, so its Phi lands below the bromine molecule despite being more active. Ligand 1 is the acetyl probe and atom 17 is its cyclopropane CH bonded to the carbonyl at atom 15 - the anchor for the best cap. A vinyl is the gap in the size series at C4. Methyl at 0.49 is too small and ethynyl at 0.59 is right; vinyl sits between them in bulk, is all-carbon like both, and is far cheaper than the alkyne on synthetic accessibility, which cost the ethynyl molecule 0.2 of SA. At 279 Da it is also one of the lightest candidates that could plausibly carry full activity, so if the C4 requirement really is just occupancy this should be close to the ideal compromise. Expected product: about 279 Da.
